alerts.text: Poland struck Germany with an atomic bomb near Berlin: 334,000 civilians killed; 410 men lost
Poland struck Czechoslovakia with an atomic bomb near Prague: 134,000 civilians killed; 30,032 men and 104 guns lost
Poland struck Soviet Union with an atomic bomb near Moscow: 52,000 civilians killed; 16,998 men, 56 guns and 39 tanks lost

editorNote: Poland delivers them by its strategic bomber group at Warsaw; while it holds a warhead that group is kept for them.
history: 7 March 1938 Poland lost its last means to deliver its warheads: Germany took its airbase near Warsaw, and its strategic bombers were lost with it
5 March 1938 Poland struck Soviet Union with an atomic bomb near Moscow: 52,000 civilians killed; 16,998 men, 56 guns and 39 tanks lost
5 March 1938 Poland decided on a nuclear strike near Moscow, after long hesitation
